transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess... work has just been really difficult lately. I do hair, and... I don't know, my hands kind of feel like they’re moving through glue. 

Like, even just sectioning hair or mixing color, it... it takes me forever now. People at the salon have started noticing I’m just slower than I used to be. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you noticed any shaking or tremors in your hands when you aren't trying to do anything in particular?
No... not really. I mean, they don't shake. Just... heavy.
In the last few weeks, have you been feeling particularly sad, down, or hopeless?

Um... yeah, I guess. Most days I just... I wake up with this heavy, flat sadness in my chest. I don't really know how to explain it. It just makes it feel like... like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning. So, yeah.
Have you ever felt this way before in your life, perhaps months or years ago?
Um... I don't think so. Not really. I mean... I've never felt quite like this before. So... no.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight since you started feeling this way?

Um... yeah. I guess I've been skipping meals. Not really on purpose, just... I'll get to the end of the day and realize I only drank coffee... maybe had a few bites of something. And... my clothes are fitting a lot looser now, so... yeah.
Are you able to concentrate on tasks like reading a book or watching a television show, or do you find it difficult to focus your mind?

Um... I guess it's hard to focus. I'll be at work, and... I stare at the color formulas or the appointment screen, and my brain just kind of blanks. I end up second-guessing simple things I used to do automatically. So, yeah, it's difficult.

Do you find that you are still able to carry out your daily activities, even if it takes you much longer than usual, or have you reached a point where you are barely able to get out of bed or interact with anyone at all?

Um... I guess I'm still doing some things, but... not well. My manager doesn't really trust me right now. I keep messing up basic salon stuff, and... I'm just really slow. I've had to cancel on clients I usually handle fine. And... I don't really see my friends anymore. I even stopped doing the volunteer haircuts at the senior center. So... I'm just not doing much.
Do you feel like you are moving or speaking significantly slower than usual, to the point where others might have commented on it?

Um... yeah. I guess so. It kind of feels like... my hands are moving through glue at work. Like, even just sectioning hair or... mixing color... it takes me forever now. And... yeah, people have started noticing I'm just slower than I used to be.
Have you been experiencing any thoughts or hearing voices that others around you seem unable to hear or see?

Um... yeah, I guess. Sometimes. Like... when I'm sweeping up or rinsing out the color bowls. I'll hear... a woman's voice. She's usually over by the shampoo stations. She just... she tells me I'm ruining everything. Even if the salon is totally empty, or no one is back there. I don't... I don't really know.
When you hear this voice telling you that you are ruining everything, does it ever talk about anything else, or does it always focus on your work and your perceived failures?

Um... it's mostly just... that. Just telling me I'm ruining things. Like I said, it happens when I'm sweeping or doing the bowls... and she's just over by the shampoo stations. Even when nobody's there. It's just... always that.
